# GST Concepts
> Office furniture and interiors supplier in Oman, representing a portfolio of international furniture brands.

GST Concepts is a Muscat-based commercial furniture supplier serving the Sultanate of Oman, operating locally under Gulf Service and Trading. It is the authorized regional partner in Oman for five international brands — Leadcom, Audia Italia, Scab, Brunonic, and Nitrocare — covering auditorium and cinema seating, office and workplace furniture, and hospital and healthcare furniture for commercial and institutional projects. Customers are architects, contractors, and businesses running fit-out projects who need one point of contact across multiple furniture categories rather than a separate supplier per category.

- [Partners](https://www.gstconcepts.om/partners): International furniture brands GST Concepts represents/distributes — a curated house of European brands sharing a commitment to quality, design, and functionality.

## Products & Brands
- [Collection](https://www.gstconcepts.om/collection): Full GST Concepts catalogue — every product across all five brands in one place.
- [Audia](https://www.gstconcepts.om/audia): Audia Italia seating, sourced, customized, and supplied for venues in Oman.
- [SCAB](https://www.gstconcepts.om/scab): S•CAB furniture, sourced and supplied for commercial and workplace projects in Oman.
- [Leadcom](https://www.gstconcepts.om/leadcom): Leadcom auditorium, retractable, cinema, and workstation seating, supplied and installed for projects in Oman.
- [Brunonic](https://www.gstconcepts.om/brunonic): Brunonic office furniture, sourced and supplied for commercial fit-outs in Oman.
- [Nitrocare](https://www.gstconcepts.om/nitrocare): Nitrocare healthcare furniture, sourced, supplied, and installed for hospital and clinic projects in Oman.
